name: bookstore-webapp

dependencies.name: catalog-service
dependencies.description: Lists and searches books, shows book detail, and lets Store Staff manage the catalog.

dependencies.name: customers-service
dependencies.description: Lets the signed-in Shopper manage their profile and shipping addresses.

dependencies.name: cart-service
dependencies.description: Lets the signed-in Shopper manage their cart before checkout.

dependencies.name: orders-service
dependencies.description: Checks out the Shopper's cart and shows their order history and status.

dependencies.name: inventory-service
dependencies.description: Shows stock availability and lets Store Staff adjust stock and view reservations.

dependencies.name: notifications-service
dependencies.description: Shows the signed-in Shopper's in-app order-status notifications.

description: The React storefront SPA: public catalog browsing and search, Shopper account/cart/checkout/order-history/notifications screens behind sign-in, and a Store Staff area for catalog and inventory management. Holds no business data itself — every screen is backed by one of the six services.
